flashcard_questions.q: What is formed when a metal reacts with oxygen?
What does it mean if an oxide is amphoteric?
flashcard_questions.a: It reacts with both acids and alkalis.

flashcard_questions.q: Which two oxides in this topic are amphoteric?
What makes one metal more reactive than another?
flashcard_questions.a: It loses electrons more easily to form positive ions.

flashcard_questions.q: Which two metals react violently with cold water?
What happens when iron is added to copper sulfate solution?
flashcard_questions.a: The iron displaces the copper, which coats it orange-brown.

flashcard_questions.q: What colour change shows iron displacing copper from copper sulfate?
flashcard_questions.a: The blue solution turns pale green.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the thermite reaction used for in industry?
What is an ore in mining?
flashcard_questions.a: A rock containing enough metal compound to make extraction worthwhile.

flashcard_questions.q: Why are gold and platinum found naturally as pure elements?
flashcard_questions.a: They are unreactive, so they do not easily combine with other substances.
